title: Fix Admin Button Flash/Disappear on Live

requirements.text: In the Navigation component, fix the admin button flashing behavior by adding a hardcoded principal fallback: if the authenticated principal matches the owner's known principal, treat the user as admin regardless of the backend `isCallerAdmin` call result. This ensures the Admin link is shown even if the backend call is slow or fails.

quotes: Verwende fallback: Zeig Button immer für meine Principal
Der Admin-Button blinkt kurz beim Laden und verschwindet dann.

acceptanceCriteria: The Admin navigation link does not flash or disappear on page load for the admin principal.
A hardcoded fallback principal check is implemented in the Navigation component so that the known admin principal always sees the Admin link.
The fallback is applied even when `isCallerAdmin` backend call is still loading or returns an error.

requirements.text: In `useIsCallerAdmin.ts` and/or `useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout.ts`, suppress the loading-then-false flash: hold the admin UI in a 'loading/indeterminate' state (do not render the button as hidden) until the backend call either resolves successfully or times out. Only set `isAdmin = false` after a definitive response or timeout, not during initial load.

quotes: Der Admin-Button blinkt kurz beim Laden und verschwindet dann.
Entferne oder kommentiere den Call vorübergehend aus, damit Button bleibt.

acceptanceCriteria: The Admin button/link is not rendered at all (neither shown nor hidden) while the admin status check is still loading.
The Admin button only disappears if the backend definitively returns `false` for `isCallerAdmin` after the call resolves.
No flash of the Admin button followed by its removal occurs for non-admin users.

requirements.text: Verify that the `isCallerAdmin` backend method in `backend/main.mo` is accessible on the live canister for authenticated callers. Ensure the method is `public` and returns a stable result for the admin principal. Add a diagnostic trace or log if helpful.

quotes: Stelle sicher, dass der Backend-Call (isAdmin / auth check) auf Live funktioniert.

acceptanceCriteria: The `isCallerAdmin` method is publicly accessible in the main actor.
The method correctly returns `true` for the designated admin principal on the live canister.
No unauthorized or anonymous access silently returns `false` without proper error state.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
The hardcoded admin principal fallback must only be used as a safety net — do not remove the backend isCallerAdmin call entirely.
The admin principal hardcode must be clearly commented as a temporary fallback to be replaced once the backend call is confirmed stable.
nonGoals: Replacing Internet Identity authentication with another auth system.
Adding new admin features or dashboard changes.
Changing the visual design or styling of the navigation.
